description: This file contains unit tests for the Builder component of a documentation directory structure (likely for a static site generator or documentation tool). It uses PHPUnit framework to test methods related to directory and page creation, removal of sorting information from strings, handling of filenames including Unicode, ignored files, and front matter parsing.

classes.name: BuilderTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the Builder class functionality in directory and page management within a documentation structure.

methods.name: providerRemoveSorting
methods.description: Data provider supplying test cases for stripping sorting prefixes from filenames.

methods.name: testRemoveSorting
methods.description: Tests the static method removeSortingInformations to ensure it correctly strips sorting info from various filenames.

methods.name: testGetOrCreateDirNew
methods.description: Tests creation of a new directory node using Builder::getOrCreateDir.

methods.name: testGetOrCreateDirExisting
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an existing directory node, expecting to get the same Directory object.

methods.name: getStaticRoot
methods.description: Creates and returns a configured Root object with valid content extensions, used for tests.

methods.name: providerCreatePage
methods.description: Data provider with sample filenames and expected page properties.

methods.name: testGetOrCreatePage
methods.description: Verifies the creation of page entries with correct URL, URI, and title.

methods.name: testChangeUri
methods.description: Tests updating the URI of an existing page entry and verifies URL updates.

methods.name: testGetOrCreatePageAutoMarkdown
methods.description: Ensures that pages without explicit extension default to Markdown handling.

methods.name: testGetOrCreateIndexPage
methods.description: Tests creation of index pages with special 'index.md' filename and custom titles.

methods.name: testGetOrCreatePageExisting
methods.description: Tests that an existing page object is reused rather than recreated.

methods.name: testGetOrCreateRawPage
methods.description: Tests creation of raw file representations, e.g., JSON files.

methods.name: testUnicodeFilenames
methods.description: Checks proper handling and normalization of filenames with Unicode characters.

methods.name: testIgnoredFiles
methods.description: Verifies that specified ignore patterns exclude files and folders correctly.

methods.name: testIndexFrontMatter
methods.description: Tests that front matter in index.md files correctly set page titles.
